bio1: With over 3 years of hands-on experience, I'm Mehrajul Karim, a Dhaka‑ and Chittagong‑based Visual Storyteller specializing in portraits, commercial, and documentary work. I take a warm, collaborative approach—combining creative vision with professional craft to capture authentic moments and deliver cinematic, emotion‑driven visuals. I'm certified in documentary filmmaking and available across Bangladesh for projects, events and location shoots.
bio2: I believe every frame should feel true. I enjoy partnering with clients to shape visual narratives that connect with audiences and leave lasting impressions.
